info.title: posterProjects Mobile API
info.description: Stateless bearer-token surface at /api/v1, consumed by the posterMobile Flutter client. Tokens are Laravel Sanctum personal access tokens named `mobile` with the `mobile` ability, separate from the web session app and the `/mcp` bearer surface (which uses the `mcp` ability). This document describes the surface as implemented, including the exact JSON error contract.

servers.description: Relative to the application origin. Paths below already include the full /api/v1 prefix.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Credentials-to-token exchange, identity, and revocation for the mobile bearer surface.

tags.name: Projects
tags.description: Read-only project list and detail for the posterMobile client. Writes are a separate change.

post.summary: Exchange credentials for a mobile bearer token
post.description: Validates the owner's email and password without starting a web session (Auth::validate(), never Auth::attempt()). On success, revokes every prior token named `mobile` before minting a new one named `mobile` with exactly the `mobile` ability. A pre-existing `mcp` token is never touched. Throttled by the named limiter `api-login`: 5 attempts per minute keyed by `email|ip`, and 10 attempts per minute keyed by `ip` alone; both successful and failed attempts count toward each limit.

200.description: Credentials valid. Returns the plain-text token; it is never shown again.

422.description: Missing/invalid fields, or a recognized-but-wrong email/password pair. Bad credentials are reported under the `email` field, reusing the existing Spanish copy.

value.message: Estas credenciales no coinciden con nuestros registros.

email: Estas credenciales no coinciden con nuestros registros.

429.description: 6th attempt within the one-minute window for the same email+IP, or 11th for the same IP.

example.message: Demasiados intentos de acceso. Por favor, inténtalo de nuevo en 42 segundos.

get.description: Requires a bearer token carrying the `mobile` ability (or the legacy wildcard `['*']` ability). Exposes exactly id, name, and email — no other user attribute.

401.description: No token, or a token that does not authenticate.

403.description: A valid token that lacks the `mobile` ability (e.g. an `mcp`-only token).

example.message: Este token no tiene permiso para usar esta API.

get.summary: List the authenticated owner's active projects
get.description: Returns the requesting user's active (non-archived) projects, scoped by membership, ordered by name then id. Requires the `mobile` ability. There is no pagination envelope today: `data` is always the complete result set. Forward-compatibility rule for the client: if a future response omits `meta`, `data` is still the complete set — there is no next page. If `meta` is present, the last page is reached when `meta.current_page === meta.last_page` (equivalently `links.next === null`). A client written against this rule never breaks and never has to assume the response has exactly one key.

200.description: The member's active projects, ordered by name.

401.description: No token, or a token that does not authenticate.

403.description: A valid token that lacks the `mobile` ability (e.g. an `mcp`-only token).

example.message: Este token no tiene permiso para usar esta API.

get.summary: Resolve a single project by key, active or archived
get.description: Resolves `{project}` against the project's `key` column for any project the requesting user is a member of, including a soft-deleted (archived) one — a stale link to an archived project still resolves so the client can render a meaningful state instead of a dead end. Requires the `mobile` ability. Unknown key, non-member key, and force-deleted key are indistinguishable: all three respond `404` with the identical generic body, never `403` — the response never discloses whether an inaccessible key exists.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: The project's `key` (e.g. DEMO) — never the numeric `id`.

401.description: No token, or a token that does not authenticate.

403.description: A valid token that lacks the `mobile` ability (e.g. an `mcp`-only token).

example.message: Este token no tiene permiso para usar esta API.

404.description: No project with this key is resolvable for the requesting user: the key never existed, belongs to a project the user is not a member of, or was permanently force-deleted. These three causes are intentionally indistinguishable.

post.description: Revokes only the token used to authenticate the request, via currentAccessToken(). Every other token (of either name) is left untouched. Requires the `mobile` ability.

bearerAuth.description: Plain-text Sanctum token minted by POST /api/v1/login, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Carries the `mobile` ability (or the legacy wildcard `['*']`).

token.description: Plain-text Sanctum token. Shown once; not recoverable afterward.

id.description: Stable local primary key. Never used to address the resource.

issues_count.description: Eager-loaded aggregate; never triggers a query per project.

archived.description: True only when the project is soft-deleted.

errors.description: Field name to array of error messages.
